data.one_liner: Widget that renders BBCode strings into styled Flutter text
data.what_it_does: It parses BBCode markup and displays it as Flutter text widgets. Custom tags and styles can be added via a stylesheet.
use_when: You need to display BBCode formatted text in a Flutter app
You want to support custom BBCode tags or styles
You want selectable text with accessibility support
avoid_when: You need to parse other markup languages like Markdown or HTML
You require complex layout or interactive widgets beyond text
strengths: Easy to integrate, single widget API
Supports custom tags and styles via BBStylesheet
weaknesses: No built‑in support for other markup or rich media beyond images
Requires manual tag definitions for custom behavior
